questions.question:

Reason (R): Females receive a better diet.

options.text: A is true but R is false.
A is false but R is true.
Both A and R are true.
Both A and R are false.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option **__1__**, i.e. __**A is true and R is false**__.

questions.question:
Vikash purchased 5 bananas for Rs. 4 and sold 4 bananas for Rs. 5. Calculate his % profit?

A. 55.56%

B. 53.25%

C. 45.50%

D. 56.25%
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Vikash purchased 5 bananas for Rs. 4 and sold 4 bananas for Rs. 5

Formula Used:

Profit = SP - CP

Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

Vikash purchased 5 bananas for Rs. 4

⇒ Cost Price of 1 banana = Rs. 4/5

Vikash sold 4 bananas for Rs. 5

⇒ Selling Price of 1 banana = Rs. 5/4

Profit = 5/4 - 4/5 = 9/20

∴ Profit % = (9/20)/(4/5) × 100 = 56.25%

__**Alternate Solution**__

To make our calculation easy, we can make the number of purchasing bananas and selling bananas equal.

Hence, 

Cost price of 20 bananas = 4 × 4 = 16

Selling price of 20 bananas = 5 × 5 = 25

Profit = 25 - 16 = 9

∴ Profit % = (9/16) × 100 = 56.25%

questions.question:
Anil can do a piece of work in 14 days which Rohit can do in 21 days. They worked together for few days after which Anil left. If Rohit worked alone for 3 days, find the total number of days it took to complete the whole work.

A. 31/5

B. 51/5

C. 21/5

D. 13/5
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Anil can do a piece of work in 14 days

Rohit can do a piece of work in 21 days

They worked together for few days after which Anil left

Rohit worked alone for 3 days

**Calculation:**

Anil can do a piece of work in 14 days

⇒ 1 day work of Anil = 1/14 unts

Rohit can do a piece of work in 21 days

⇒ 1 day work of Rohit = 1/21 units 

According to the question,

Work done by Anil in 3 days = 3/21 units = 1/7 units

Remaining work = 1 - 1/7 = 6/7 units

Remaining work is done by A and B together 

Work done done by A and B together in 1 day = 1/14 + 1/21 = 5/42 units 

⇒ Number of days A and B work together = (6/7)/(5/42) = 7.2 days 

∴ Total work is completed in 7.2 + 3 days = 10.2 days = 51/5 days

__**Alternate solution**__

Let total work be 42 units.

Efficiency of Anil = 42/14 = 3 units/day

Efficiency of Rohit = 42/21 = 2 units/day

Let both did work together for x days.

Hence, 

Work done by both in x days + Work done by Rohit in 3 days = Total work

⇒ (3 + 2)x + 2 × 3 = 42

⇒ 5x + 6 = 42

⇒ 5x = 36

⇒ x = 36/5 days

∴ Total days = x + 3 = 36/5 + 3 = 51/5 days

questions.question:
If two complimentary angles are in the ratio of 11 : 7, find the smaller angle.

A. 35° 

B. 55° 

C. 65° 

D. 25°
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of complimentary angles = 11 : 7

**Formula Used:**

Sum of complementary angles = 90°

**Calculation:**

Let the angles be 11x and 7x 

According to the question,

11x + 7x = 90° 

⇒ 18x = 90° 

⇒ x = 5° 

∴ Smallest angle = 5 × 7 = 35° 

__**Short Trick**__

Ratio of angles = 11 : 7

Smaller angle must be a multiple of 7.

In given options, only 35 is multiple of 7.

Hence, correct answer will be 35.

questions.question:
If the angles of a triangle are in the ratio of 2 : 5 : 8, then find the value of the largest angle.

B. 96° 

C. 84°

questions.solution:
**Given: **

Angles of a triangle are in the ratio of 2 : 5 : 8

**Formula Used:**

Sum of the angles of a triangle = 180° 

**Calculation:**

Let the angle of a triangles are 2x, 5x and 8x 

⇒ 2x + 5x + 8x = 180° 

⇒ 15x = 180° 

⇒ x = 12° 

∴ Largest angle of the triangle = 8 × 12 = 96° 

__**Smart trick**__

Here, ratio of angles is 2 : 5 : 8.

Hence, the largest angle must be multiple of 8.

In given options, only 96° is a multiple of 8.

∴ Correct answer will be 96°.

questions.question: The traffic lights at four different road crossings change after every 15 sec, 18 sec, 27 sec and 30 sec respectively. If they all change simultaneously at 6 : 10 : 00 hours, then at what time will they again change simultaneously?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**LCM** of 15, 18, 27, and 30 represents the **time interval** for simultaneous changes.

LCM(15, 18, 27, 30) = 270 seconds.

Convert 270 seconds to minutes → 270 ÷ 60 = 4 minutes 30 seconds.

Add this to the initial time: 6 : 10 : 00 + 4 min 30 sec = 6 : 14 : 30 hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 6 : 14 : 30 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Intervals are 15 sec, 18 sec, 27 sec, and 30 sec. Initial time = 6 : 10 : 00 hr.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb032b10aec360b7849a1ad3d0f7b44a95b8d072e0e5a7119631646412240c6f.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Prime factorization of 15 = 3 × 5

⇒ Prime factorization of 18 = 2 × 3²

⇒ Prime factorization of 27 = 3³

⇒ Prime factorization of 30 = 2 × 3 × 5

⇒ **LCM** = 2 × 3³ × 5 = 2 × 27 × 5 = 270 seconds

⇒ Time in minutes = 270 ÷ 60 = 4.5 minutes = 4 minutes 30 seconds

⇒ Final time = 6 : 10 : 00 + 0 : 04 : 30 = 6 : 14 : 30 hr

**∴ The correct answer is 6 : 14 : 30 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM Application

The **Least Common Multiple (LCM)** is used to find the first instance when multiple events with different periodicities coincide.

Unit Conversion

Always ensure all time units are consistent (e.g., all seconds) before calculating the LCM and convert back to **HH:MM:SS** format for the final result.

Successive Meetings

If the question asks for the 'n-th' time they meet, the time required is n × LCM.</p

questions.question: A spoon which looks bent in water is an example of which of the following?
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT:__

Refraction: When a ray of light passes from one medium to another it suffers a change in direction at the boundary of two media is called refraction.

__
 
• The change in direction because the speed of light travels at different speeds in different mediums.
 
• Refractive Index of a medium defines that it is denser or rarer
 
• Refractive Index = Speed of light in Vacuum /speed of light in that medium.
 
• Refractive Index = η = c/v where, c = Speed of light in Vacuum, v = speed of light in that medium.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2d07058265f88582d8853427088b9afa911fc02787e2ff1836f69dab0b940d8.png] 

 

**Explanation:**__

When light passes from a region of lower n, such as air, through a surface into a region of higher n, such as glass, the light changes direction. This means its path is closer to perpendicular, or "normal," to the surface. When the light passes from a region of higher n to the region of lower n, it bends away from the "normal" direction. This is what causes the submerged part of a spoon in a glass of water to appear to bend when you put it in water.

__**Extra point:**__

Reflection: It can be defined as bouncing back of light, on the shiny smooth surface.

__
 
• It is done in a single medium no change of medium is seen.
 
• It follows law’s of reflection

1) Angle of incidence = Angle of reflection

2) The incident ray, the reflected ray, and normal to the surface of incidence always lies in the same plane.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7fae18d68eb9efdd6693f4dc64cd85d60034da19b80c5df66b8f6d965dfa362.png] 

Total Internal reflection: The total reflection of light from a higher refractive index medium to back in its medium at an angle more than a critical angle known as total internal reflection.

 
• It always happens when light travels from denser medium to rarer medium.
 
• At critical angle θc it makes 90° angle with normal separating two media.
 
• Sin ic = n2/n1 [where n2 = rarer medium, n1 = denser medium].

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d07303f217dc34b1eb0aa5c3b24faa85c60afe7c579eda90314a82a1a7aaa98e.png] 

EXPLANATION__:

A coin in a beaker filled with water appears raised because of Refraction.

questions.question: Sonam’s age after eight years will be half of her father’s age. Eight years ago the ratio of their ages was 1 : 3. Find the present age of Sonam's father?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of ages (**Sonam** : **Father**) 8 years ago = 1 : 3 (Difference = 2 units).

Ratio after 8 years = 1 : 2 → 2 : 4 (Multiplied by 2 to make the age difference constant at 2 units).

Increase in ratio units = 4 − 3 = 1 unit.

Actual time gap = 8 + 8 = 16 years ∴ 1 unit = 16 years.

Father's age 8 years ago = 3 units = 3 × 16 = 48 years.

**Father's present age** = 48 + 8 = 56 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 56.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c1d7ec3dc7c682400366401789b2be37496eb65a641d882338a965e43b1ba65.png] 

Let the ages of **Sonam** and her **father** 8 years ago be x and 3x respectively.

**Present age** of Sonam = x + 8

**Present age** of father = 3x + 8

According to the question, after 8 years:

⇒ (Sonam's present age + 8) = 1/2 × (Father's present age + 8)

⇒ (x + 8 + 8) = 1/2 × (3x + 8 + 8)

⇒ x + 16 = 1/2 × (3x + 16)

⇒ 2 × (x + 16) = 3x + 16

⇒ 2x + 32 = 3x + 16

⇒ 3x − 2x = 32 − 16

⇒ x = 16

**Father's present age** = 3x + 8

⇒ 3 × 16 + 8

⇒ 48 + 8 = 56 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 56.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The difference between the ages of two persons always remains the same, regardless of how many years pass or have passed.

Ratio Balancing Method

To solve age ratio problems quickly, multiply the ratios so that the difference between the ratio parts of the two individuals becomes equal in both time periods.

Time Gap Calculation

If one condition is 'n' years ago and the other is 'm' years later, the total time gap between the two conditions is (n + m) years.</p

questions.question: The average of five consecutive even numbers is 40. What is the value of smallest of these numbers?

**Given:**

Average of 5 consecutive even number = 40

Average = (Sum of all the terms/Total number of terms)

**Calculation:**

From the given data,

Let us consider five consecutive even numbers be x, x + 2, x + 4, x + 6, x + 8

⇒ (x + x + 2 + x + 4 + x + 6 + x + 8)/5 = 40

⇒ 5x + 20 = 200

⇒ 5x = 180

⇒ x = 180/5 = 36

**∴ Smallest of the numbers is 36**

questions.question: If (a + c + 1) = 0, then find the value of (a³ + c³ + 1 – 3ac)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

According to the **algebraic identity**, if the sum of three terms is zero (i.e., **x + y + z = 0**), then the value of **x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz** is always **0**.

Here, the given condition is **a + c + 1 = 0**, which fits the form **x + y + z = 0** where x = a, y = c, and z = 1.

The expression **a³ + c³ + 1 − 3ac** corresponds exactly to **x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz**.

Therefore, since the sum of the variables is **0**, the entire expression evaluates to **0**.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** a + c + 1 = 0

**Formula Used:** x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = (x + y + z)(x² + y² + z² − xy − yz − zx)

⇒ Let **x = a**, **y = c**, and **z = 1**.

⇒ The expression to find is **a³ + c³ + 1³ − 3(a)(c)(1)**.

⇒ Substituting the values into the **expansion formula**:

⇒ a³ + c³ + 1 − 3ac = (**a + c + 1**) × (a² + c² + 1² − ac − c − a)

⇒ Since it is given that **a + c + 1 = 0**:

⇒ a³ + c³ + 1 − 3ac = **0** × (a² + c² + 1 − ac − c − a)

⇒ a³ + c³ + 1 − 3ac = **0**

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Conditional Cubic Identity

When **x + y + z = 0**, the identity **x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz** holds true, which is frequently used in **competitive exams** to simplify complex polynomials.

Alternative Expansion

The expression **x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz** can also be written as **(1/2)(x + y + z)[(x − y)² + (y − z)² + (z − x)²]**.

Non-negative Property

The quadratic part **x² + y² + z² − xy − yz − zx** is always **greater than or equal to zero** for all real values of x, y, and z.</p

questions.question: If (x + y)² – xy = 0, then find the value of (x³ – y³)/(x - y) ?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Expand the given equation: (x + y)² − xy = x² + 2xy + y² − xy = x² + xy + y² = 0.

The expression to find is (x³ − y³)/(x − y).

Using the identity x³ − y³ = (x − y)(x² + xy + y²).

Substituting the identity: [(x − y)(x² + xy + y²)] / (x − y) = x² + xy + y².

Since x² + xy + y² = 0, the final value is 0.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(x + y)² − xy = 0

**Formula Used:**

1. (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

2. a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²)

**Calculations:**

⇒ (x + y)² − xy = 0

⇒ x² + 2xy + y² − xy = 0

⇒ x² + xy + y² = 0

Now, we need to find the value of (x³ − y³) / (x − y):

⇒ (x³ − y³) / (x − y) = [(x − y)(x² + xy + y²)] / (x − y)

⇒ x² + xy + y²

Substitute the value from the **given condition**:

⇒ 0

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

**__Additional Information__**

Sum of Cubes Identity

The identity for the sum of two cubes is x³ + y³ = (x + y)(x² − xy + y²).

Square of a Binomial

The expansion of (x − y)² is x² − 2xy + y², which differs from the sum of squares.

Difference of Squares

The identity x² − y² = (x − y)(x + y) is frequently used to simplify algebraic fractions.</p

questions.question: Atul and Binay together complete a piece of work in 5 days. If Binay alone can complete the same work in 8 days, how many days can Atul take to complete the same work alone?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Use the formula for **individual work** when **combined time** and **one person's time** are known.

Time taken by **Atul** = (A × B) ÷ (B − A)

Time = (5 × 8) ÷ (8 − 5) = 40 ÷ 3 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 40/3 days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by **Atul and Binay** (A + B) = 5 days

Time taken by **Binay** (B) = 8 days

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**

 Atul + Binay
 5
 40
 8

 Binay
 8
 5

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Total Work** = LCM of 5 and 8 = 40 units

⇒ **Efficiency** of (Atul + Binay) = 40 ÷ 5 = 8 units/day

⇒ **Efficiency** of Binay = 40 ÷ 8 = 5 units/day

⇒ **Efficiency** of **Atul** = Efficiency of (Atul + Binay) − Efficiency of Binay

⇒ **Efficiency** of Atul = 8 − 5 = 3 units/day

⇒ Time taken by **Atul** = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of Atul

⇒ Time = 40 ÷ 3 days

**∴ The correct answer is 40/3 days.**

**__Additional Information__**

Combined Work Formula

If person X takes x days and person Y takes y days, together they take (x × y) ÷ (x + y) days.

Efficiency and Time Relation

Efficiency is **inversely proportional** to the time taken to complete the work (E ∝ 1/T).

Work and Wages

Wages are generally distributed in the **ratio of efficiency** or the **ratio of work done** by each person.</p

questions.question: In new government policy, the price of onion is raised by 35%. By what % should a person reduce onion consumption so that the expenditure on it does not increase?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct percentage reduction formula: **Reduction %** = [r ÷ (100 + r)] × 100

Here, r = 35% (increase in **onion price**).

⇒ Reduction % = [35 ÷ (100 + 35)] × 100

⇒ Reduction % = (35 ÷ 135) × 100 = (7 ÷ 27) × 100

⇒ Reduction % = 25.92% ≈ 26%

**∴ The correct answer is 26%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Increase in price = 35% | Target: No change in **expenditure**.

**Formula Used:** Expenditure = Price × Consumption. If Expenditure is constant, Price and Consumption are **inversely proportional**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70fc41f4b67b503d6df3368ac2fb9930e48adb6fd6db4e10b9b4ef49707882f2.png] 

⇒ Let the **initial price** be ₹100 and **initial consumption** be 100 units.

⇒ Initial Expenditure = 100 × 100 = ₹10,000.

⇒ New Price = ₹135.

⇒ Since Expenditure must remain ₹10,000, New Consumption = 10,000 ÷ 135.

⇒ New Consumption = 74.07 units.

⇒ **Reduction in consumption** = 100 − 74.07 = 25.93 units.

⇒ Percentage Reduction = (25.93 ÷ 100) × 100 = 25.93% ≈ 26%.

**∴ The correct answer is 26%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Price-Consumption Relationship

When the expenditure is constant, the ratio of price is the inverse of the ratio of consumption. If price ratio is a : b, consumption ratio must be b : a.

Percentage Increase-Decrease Duality

If one quantity increases by r%, the other must decrease by [r ÷ (100 + r)] × 100% to keep the product constant.

Rounding in Exams

Competitive exams often require rounding the final calculation (like 25.92%) to the nearest whole number provided in the options.

questions.question: The mean of 10 observations is 13. Two more observations are included and the new mean becomes 14. The mean of two new observations is
questions.solution:
Given that mean of 10 observations is 13

∴ Sum of 10 observations = 10 × 13 = 130

Also given that when two observations are included the new mean is 14

⇒ Mean of 12 observations = 14

∴ Sum of 12 observations = 12 × 14 = 168

⇒ Sum of two observations which are added = sum of 12 observations - sum of 10 observations

= 168 - 130 = 38

⇒ Mean of the two observations which are added = 38/2 = 19

questions.question: If the standard deviation of a population is 6.5, what would be the population variance?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Standard deviation = σ = 6.5

**Calculation**

We know that variance is the square of the standard deviation

**∴ Variance = (standard deviation)² = (σ)² = 6.5² = 42.25**

questions.question: How many natural numbers between 15 and 85 are divisible by 7?
questions.solution:
The multiple of 7between 15 to 85 are (21, 28, 35, 42, 49, 56, 63, 70, 77, 84)

∴ There are a total of 10 numbers which are divisible by 7 between 15 to 85

__**Alternate Method**__

In between 15 and 85 smallest number divisible by 7 is 21 and largest number is 84.

We know,

Last number = First number + (n - 1) × Common difference

⇒ 84 = 21 + (n - 1) × 7

⇒ 63 = 7(n - 1)

⇒ n - 1 = 9

⇒ n = 10

questions.question: Who discovered the AB-O blood group system?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Karl Landsteiner**__.

 
• Karl Landsteiner found out that the blood of two people under contact agglutinates, and in 1901 he found that this effect was due to contact of blood with blood serum. As a result, he succeeded in identifying the three blood groups A, B and O, which he labelled C, of human blood.
 
• Karl Koller was an Austrian ophthalmologist, Koller introduced cocaine as a local anaesthetic for eye surgery.
 
• Maurice Ralph Hilleman was an American microbiologist who specialised in vaccinology and developed over 40 vaccines, which consists of measles, mumps, hepatitis A, hepatitis B, chickenpox, meningitis, pneumonia and Haemophilus influenza bacteria. 
 
• Edward Jenner was an English physician and scientist who was the pioneer of smallpox vaccine.

questions.question: HCF of two numbers is 19 and their LCM is 665. If one of the number is 95, find the other.
questions.solution:
From the given data,

We can write it as LCM × HCF = first number × other number

⇒ 19 × 665 = 95 × other number

⇒ Other number = 12635/95 = 133
